# Property CurrentPrinterName

#### CurrentPrinterName

Gets or sets the name of the current printer.

##### Declaration

```
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
string CurrentPrinterName { get; set; }
```

##### Property Value

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  string |   |  

##### Remarks

This property is available since v7.6.
